input.quote: Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
input.rationale: A USD 6M multi-year take-or-pay expressly stripped of reduction or termination rights is our walk-away position, and it contradicts both Section 12.3 (no minimum-volume commitment) and Section 9.4 (convenience termination with refund), which it would render worthless. Redlined to the fallback: commitment limited to the current 12-month term, reducible on 30 days' notice, settled by true-up rather than penalty, and expressly subject to our termination rights.

input.quote: Immediately on termination Vendor shall discontinue all assistance and permanently delete Customer Data without offering an export or migration support.
input.rationale: Immediate deletion of Customer Data with no export or migration support is our walk-away position and directly contradicts 11.2 (30-day return in machine-readable format) and 11.3 (deletion only after we confirm successful return, with officer certification). Redlined to replace 11.1 with up to six months of transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates and to make deletion subject to 11.2–11.3, aligning the section with our preferred position.
